dataset.name: longmemeval
dataset.license: MIT (Hugging Face dataset card xiaowu0162/longmemeval-cleaned; GitHub repository LICENSE)

hardware.gpu: none used (CPU-only ONNX inference inside memnest)

config.memory_format: one memory per dialog turn: '[<session date>] ' + 'User said: ' / 'Assistant answered: ' + content
config.add_metadata: chunk_type=auto_log, importance=log, source=bench.transcript, adapter=bench, session_id=<dataset session>, event_id=<dataset turn id>, sequence=1, total=1
config.project_scope: one project per conversation (LoCoMo) / per question haystack (LongMemEval)

depth_probe_request.purpose: diagnostic only, not used in headline metrics except where labelled @50

config.server_defaults: no env overrides (MEMNEST_* removed); mmr_lambda=0.5, distance_cutoff=0.7, low_relevance_fallback=3

performance.ingest_note: no ingest: every part asked its questions against a kept data directory
performance.latency_note: not reported: the parts were timed separately
